channel.title: Naples Chess Club
channel.description: Guides, research and practical chess advice from Naples Chess Club.

item.title: Chess in Naples, Florida: The Complete Guide
item.description: Where to play chess in Naples, what a club night actually involves, what it costs, and how to start playing over the board if you are new to the area or new to the game.

item.title: The Chess Opening Principles Checklist (Free, Printable)
item.description: Seven opening principles that beat memorising lines for any player under about 1500. Includes a one-page printable checklist you can take to the board.

item.title: Does Chess Actually Make You Smarter? What the Research Says
item.description: A careful look at the evidence on chess and cognition, including the dementia study that gets quoted constantly and the meta-analyses that find far less than people claim.
